dogecoin.text: The jobs report stunk, the stock market is at record highs, Dogecoin is worth more than Ford, crypto is a $2 trillion market and Elon is hosting SNL this weekend -- a potentially market-moving episode. What kind of alternate reality is this?

@elonmusk @CathieDWood @jack Elon says he owns bitcoin, ethereum and dogecoin, but owns much more bitcoin than the cryptos. So the announcement earlier this year that Tesla would at least temporarily stop accepting Bitcoin due to concerns over the environment were personally detrimental to him.
